title: Mobility Equipment Warranty Terms — First-Weeks Diagnostic Allowance on Controller Replacements
content:
# First-Weeks Diagnostic Allowance — Controller Replacements on Mobility Equipment

**Term.** A first-weeks diagnostic allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty joystick or controller replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the days from the chair's delivery date to the day the controller claim is posted: 2 units for no more than 14 days, 1 unit for more than 14 but no more than 90 days, and nothing for a longer span.

| Days from the delivery date to the posting day | First-weeks diagnostic allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | 2 units |
| 15 to 90 | 1 unit |
| 91 or more | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, chair delivered 1 January of a non-leap year)

| Controller claim posted | Days since delivery | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 15 January | 14 | 2 units |
| 16 January | 15 | 1 unit |
| 1 April | 90 | 1 unit |
| 2 April | 91 | none |

The delivery date is the one on the chair's wheelchair record; the end of the count is the day the controller claim is posted.
